defendant: RICHARD SOKAN A/K/A RICHARD B. SOKAN, ET ALS.
description:
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000388
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01029525
CITIZENS BANK, N.A., is the Plaintiff, and RICHARD SOKAN A/K/A
RICHARD B. SOKAN, ET ALS., are
Defendants, writ of execution for
the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 02/18/2026.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 6TH DAY of MAY
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty
o’ clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP of SOUTH
BRUNSWICK, in the County of
MIDDLESEX, and the State of New
Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 86
Kendall Road, Kendall Park, New
Jersey 08824;
Lot: 29, Block: 318.
Dimensions of Lot (approximately):
103' x 162'
Nearest Cross Street: Hodge Road.
Approx Upset Price: $112,000.00.
Property Status: Borrower Occupied.
Subject to senior mortgage
"Deutsche Bank National Trust
Company" approx. in the amount of
$218,708.63, third parties must
obtain and payoff– Attorney representing senior mortgage Stern &
Eisenberg, senior mortgage docket
F-008411-25.
Subject to UCC Financing Statement recorded 8/26/2016 BK 2153
PG 140, interested parties/third
parties must research and obtain
their own investigation.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, munictpal liens or other charges, and any
such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances
made by plaintiff prior to this sale.
The amount due can be obtained
from the local taxing authority.
Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale
may also be subject to the limited
lien priority of any Condominium/
Homeowners Association liens
which may exist.
All interested parties are to
conduct and rely upon their own
independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding
interest remain of record and/or
have priority over the lien being
foreclosed and, if so, the current
amount due thereon.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of NINETY NINE THOUSAND
FOUR HUNDRED FIFTY SEVEN
DOLLARS AND THIRTEEN CENTS
($99,457.13) dollars more or less,
plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Attorney:
MCCABE, WEISBERG & CONWAY LLC
216 HADDON AVENUE, SUITE 201
WESTMONT, NJ 08108
Dated: 4/7, 4/14, 4/21, 4/28/2026
